props.name: className
props.comment: Extra CSS class appended to the underlying menu button.

props.name: icon
props.comment: Override the icon. Defaults to the resource icon or `<List />`.

props.name: label
props.comment: Override the label. Defaults to the pluralised resource label.

props.name: name
props.comment:
The resource name (matches a `<Resource name>` registered in `<Admin>`).
Used to look up the definition, label, icon and list path.

props.name: onClick
props.comment: Click handler invoked after the default navigation (e.g. close drawer).
